description: entries: open violations owned by another task. They are reported as KNOWN, never as PASS, and keep `npm run check` INCOMPLETE until the owner fixes them and deletes the entry. exceptions: permanent, justified exceptions (PASS, reason printed). path ending with '/' matches a directory prefix.

entries.note: The UI still ships contract-fixture screens (api/fixtureAdapter.ts, api/fixtureRunClient.ts and the feature components that import them; main.tsx renders mode=live). Roadmap 1.5 removes the last mock path. Found by the 3.7 production-mock rule on 2026-11-11.

exceptions.reason: Shared redaction test vectors: the key-shaped strings are synthetic (e.g. AbCdEf...) and exist to prove that host and service logs mask them.
